ImageDescription.value: Tongue depressors with sequenced numbers handwritten in permanent marker: these are one of the key tools of the trade. They are used to mark & give identifiers to new nests as they are found, and to denote the number of eggs laid once the nesting tern has finished doing that over the course of a few days. All this data plus location info goes into notebooks in the field, then is input into computers later on by someone on the mainland.
